cases.question: How long after the original purchase can a monthly subscription be refunded?
cases.answer: Monthly subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of the original purchase. [refund-policy] Customers request a refund by emailing billing@example.test with the workspace ID and invoice number. [refund-policy]

cases.question: What information should a customer include when requesting a refund?
cases.answer: Customers request a refund by emailing billing@example.test with the workspace ID and invoice number. [refund-policy] Monthly subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of the original purchase. [refund-policy]

cases.question: Which plan includes SAML single sign-on and who can enable it?
cases.answer: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. [sso-setup] An organization owner enables SSO under Settings, Security, then Single sign-on. [sso-setup]

cases.question: How long are application logs retained on Standard and Enterprise plans?
cases.answer: Application logs are retained for 90 days on the Standard plan and 365 days on the Enterprise plan. [retention-policy] SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. [sso-setup]

cases.question: How quickly must an on-call engineer acknowledge a Severity 1 incident?
cases.answer: The on-call engineer acknowledges Severity 1 incidents within 15 minutes and posts customer updates every 30 minutes until mitigation. [incident-severity] A Severity 1 incident is a complete production outage or confirmed data exposure affecting multiple customers. [incident-severity]

cases.question: What is the public API rate limit and what status is returned when it is exceeded?
cases.answer: When the limit is exceeded, the service returns HTTP 429 and clients should retry with exponential backoff. [api-limits] The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. [api-limits]

cases.question: How long does a workspace export download link remain valid?
cases.answer: Organization owners can start a full workspace export from Settings, Data, then Export. [data-export] The export is delivered as a ZIP file through a signed link that expires after 24 hours. [data-export]

cases.question: Which role can delete a workspace or configure SSO?
cases.answer: Only organization owners can change billing, delete a workspace, configure SSO, or start a full data export. [roles-permissions] An organization owner enables SSO under Settings, Security, then Single sign-on. [sso-setup]

cases.question: How often do encrypted database backups run and how long are daily backups retained?
cases.answer: Encrypted database backups run every 6 hours and are stored in a separate region. [backups] Daily backups are retained for 35 days. [backups]

cases.question: What support coverage do Enterprise customers receive for Severity 1 incidents?
cases.answer: Enterprise customers receive 24/7 support for Severity 1 incidents. [support-hours] A Severity 1 incident is a complete production outage or confirmed data exposure affecting multiple customers. [incident-severity]
